title: 第524章 这个世界疯了第523章 姑父
slug: 转生反派贵族妈妈们都太爱我了
content_zh:
第524章这个世界疯了
拉克丝送出的那句“我会亲手杀了你”的“祝福”，话音还未完全散去，她自己就已经转身，准备哼着小曲离开。
肖恩看着她的背影，心里琢磨着这个女孩脑袋里的回路到底是怎么长的。
就在这时，翼楼套房的门被人从外面推开了。
没有敲门。
能在这里如此行事的，只有一个人。
缇亚娜一身戎装，英挺的身姿出现在门口。
她显然是刚从某个会议或是什么地方抽身出来，眉宇间还带着一丝挥之不去的疲惫和身为元帅的威严。
她来这里，本是想看看肖恩有没有安分待着，有没有又在动什么歪脑筋。
结果一进门，就看到了自己的宝贝侄女拉克丝，正站在肖恩的房间里。
怀里还抱着一个眼熟的礼盒。
缇亚娜的眼神瞬间冷了下来。
“拉克丝，”她的声音不高，却带着不容置疑的质问意味，“你来这里做什么？”
拉克丝看到姑姑，脸上的笑容更加灿烂了。
她完全没有察觉到空气中陡然紧张起来的气氛，像一只欢快的小鸟，几步跑到缇亚娜身边，亲昵地挽住了她的胳膊。
“姑姑，我来看看姑父。”
“……”
世界安静了。
缇亚娜整个人僵在原地，像是被一道无形的魔法定住了身形。
她维持着进门的姿势，挽着她的拉克丝感受到了她手臂肌肉瞬间的绷紧。

脑子里一片空白，嗡嗡作响，反复回荡着那两个字。
姑父。
她缓缓地，一寸一寸地，把头转向了房间里那个一脸无辜的男人。
“你，”缇亚娜的声音从牙缝里挤出来，“你跟她说了什么？”
肖恩立刻举起双手，做出一个投降的姿势，脸上的表情要多无辜有多无辜。
“天地良心，我可什么都没说。”
缇亚娜当然不信，这个男人嘴里就没几句实话。
他最擅长的就是用各种手段把事情搅得天翻地覆。
“不是姑父说的！”拉克丝见姑姑误会了，赶紧帮忙解释，“是哥哥告诉我的！”
缇亚娜的身体又是一僵。
盖伦？
那个昨天还因为这件事差点崩溃，连夜跑回王都的盖伦？
他不但没有保密，反而把这种……这种荒唐事告诉了拉克丝？
缇亚娜感觉一阵眩晕，她引以为傲的理智与自控力，在冕卫家的这两个活宝面前，正在以一种惊人的速度分崩离析。
content_en:
Chapter 524 The world is crazy
Before the words of Lux's "blessing" of "I will kill you with my own hands" were completely dissipated, she had already turned around and was about to leave humming a tune.
Sean looked at her back, wondering how the circuits in this girl's head were growing.
At this moment, the door to the wing suite was pushed open from the outside.
没有敲门。
There is only one person who can act like this here.
Tiana appeared at the door wearing a military uniform and a handsome figure.
She had obviously just come out of a meeting or somewhere, and there was still a hint of lingering fatigue and the dignity of a marshal in her brows.
She came here originally to see if Sean was calm and if he was having any other crazy ideas.
As a result, as soon as he entered the door, he saw his precious niece Lux standing in Sean's room.
There was also a familiar gift box in his arms.
Tiana's eyes instantly turned cold.
"Lux," her voice was low, but with an unmistakable questioning tone, "What are you doing here?"
When Lux saw her aunt, the smile on her face became even brighter.
She was completely unaware of the sudden tense atmosphere in the air. Like a cheerful bird, she ran to Tiana's side in a few steps and held her arm affectionately.
"Aunt, let me see my uncle."
"..."
世界安静了。
Tiana froze on the spot, as if her figure was fixed by an invisible magic.
She maintained her posture as she entered the door, and Lux, who was holding her arm, felt the muscles in her arms tighten instantly.
My mind went blank, buzzing with those two words echoing over and over again.
姑父。
Slowly, inch by inch, she turned her head towards the innocent-looking man in the room.
"You," Tiana's voice came out from between her teeth, "what did you say to her?"
Sean immediately raised his hands in a gesture of surrender, with an expression as innocent as possible.
"Conscience of heaven and earth, I didn't say anything."
Of course Tiana didn't believe it. There were few truths in this man's mouth.
What he is best at is using various means to turn things upside down.
"My uncle didn't say that!" Seeing that her aunt had misunderstood, Lux quickly helped to explain, "It was my brother who told me!"
Tiana's body stiffened again.
盖伦？
That Galen who almost collapsed because of this incident yesterday and ran back to the capital overnight?
Not only did he not keep it a secret, but he told Lux ​​this...this ridiculous thing?
Tiana felt dizzy. The reason and self-control she was proud of were falling apart at an alarming speed in front of these two living treasures of the Crown Guard family.
